name: Philippa Foot
shortBio: Oxford philosopher who was a central architect of contemporary virtue ethics, moral naturalism, and creator of the famed 'Trolley Problem' thought experiment.
centralQuestion: Can moral evaluations be derived objectively from natural human facts and virtues, rather than being mere subjective expressions or prescriptive commands?

keyWorks.title: The Problem of Abortion and the Doctrine of the Double Effect
keyWorks.description: Seminal ethical essay formulating the Trolley Problem to delineate doing vs. allowing harm.

keyWorks.title: Natural Goodness
keyWorks.description: Systematic moral treatise arguing for neo-Aristotelian ethical naturalism and species-relative human flourishing.
